title: Geometry of Living — Inheritance Laws as Cross-Generational Thermodynamic Conservation Protocols
subtitle: A PoLPEST Framework Interpretation

blocks.explanation: Inheritance law read as a conservation protocol. During life an agent accumulates structural order — wealth, land, tools, skills, social capital — which the poster treats as harvested negative entropy stored in an extended Markov blanket; at death the blanket dissolves, the steady state fails and the probability current drops to zero, and without regulation that accumulated order scatters in a local entropic spike that destroys generational advantage. Inheritance is therefore a directed, low-friction topological bridge mapping the deceased's internal assets into the extended state of a designated successor, and a will is explicit vector routing: a set of pre-compiled coordinates that minimizes post-dissolution free energy and forecloses ambiguity and multi-agent conflict. The third panel gives the weighting — inheritance defaults to agents of highest proximity of type, and inherited capital lowers the successor's baseline variational free energy so that energy can go into higher-order manifold expansion instead of survival. The fourth reads the legal matrix: intestacy law as the State's default routing algorithm when no will exists, and estate tax as a friction coefficient applied at the generational jump, sustaining the macro-social manifold and preventing feudal rigidity. The poster carries its own disclaimer that this is a conceptual research framework, not legal advice.
